verdict.rationale: Marqeta documents a first-party Marqeta MCP Server that lets your own AI agents interact with its payment platform and query a designated set of Core API endpoints. Its documented capabilities include virtual card issuance, spend controls and transaction intelligence, and a probe confirms the dedicated MCP server docs page exists. Missing for 10: connection/setup and authentication details (transport, client configuration), clarity on which endpoints beyond the 'designated set' are exposed, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
